h1: LMS Software Price in India (2026): What an LMS Really Costs, by Type and at Your Sales
dek: What LMS software costs in India, from a WordPress plugin to a custom-built app: published price ranges for each type, the costs that sit below the headline price, and the total you pay in a year at your own sales, with every competitor price taken from its official page and dated.

intro: LMS software price in India runs from no fixed fee plus 10% of each sale to ₹49,999 a month on published plans, and what you really pay depends on the type of LMS, the fee it takes on each sale and the extras it leaves out. A WordPress LMS plugin starts at $199 a year plus hosting, international platforms bill $29 to $399 a month in US dollars, Indian LMS platforms charge either a monthly fee at 0% per sale or a low fixed fee plus 3% to 10% per sale, and a custom-built app is quoted by scope.

Maybe you teach NEET biology to 60 students on WhatsApp and Zoom, or run spoken English batches from a YouTube channel. Every LMS pricing page you open looks different: one shows a yearly price, one a monthly price billed annually, one only a percentage, one only a "Book a call" button. This guide puts them on the same footing, so you can see what an LMS costs you in a year.

We are AllCoaching, one of the platforms compared here, so read this knowing who wrote it. Every competitor price below comes from that company's own pricing page, with the link and the date we checked it (6 November 2026). We did not round any figure, and where a page did not show a price clearly, we left it out.
takeaways: LMS software price in India ranges from no fixed fee + 10% per sale (Exly Starter, TagMango Basic) to ₹49,999 a month (Learnyst Business, + taxes), on official pages checked 6 Nov 2026.

Five types, five cost shapes: a WordPress plugin from $199 a year plus hosting; US platforms at $29 to $399 a month billed annually; Indian LMS monthly at 0% per sale; Indian LMS with a low fixed fee plus 3–10% per sale; a custom app quoted by scope.
The hidden costs are real: 18% GST, a payment gateway fee (Razorpay's standard rate is 2% per domestic payment, plus 18% GST on that fee), app add-ons, custom-domain setup fees and student caps.

Illustrative yearly cost at ₹2 lakh of sales ranged from ₹20,000 (Exly Starter) to ₹97,188 (Learnyst Professional billed annually) on the lowest-cost plan of each rupee platform, before GST and gateway charges.
The fee per sale decides the total as you grow: 10% of ₹10 lakh is ₹1 lakh a year, so a 0% monthly plan usually leaves more once sales pass a few lakh.

AllCoaching takes 0% commission on every monthly plan (Starter ₹3,999, Growth ₹5,999, Pro ₹7,999 a month), or yearly Starter ₹6,999 + 10%, Growth ₹12,999 + 7.5%, Pro ₹24,999 + 5%; + 18% GST; no setup fee, no sales limit, 7-day free trial with no card.

sections.h2: How much does LMS software cost in India? The short answer
sections.html:
An LMS in India costs anything from no fixed fee plus 10% of each sale to ₹49,999 a month on published plans. The type of LMS sets the shape of the bill: a plugin you host yourself, a dollar subscription, a rupee subscription at 0% per sale, a small fixed fee with a percentage, or an app built for you.

{{fig:cost-by-type|LMS software price in India by type: WordPress plugin from $199 a year, international SaaS $29 to $399 a month, Indian LMS monthly at 0% from ₹3,999 to ₹49,999 a month, Indian LMS with a fee per sale, and a custom-built app quoted by scope|Published price ranges by type, checked 6 Nov 2026, before GST. Sources in the references.}}
  • WordPress + LMS plugin: Tutor LMS Pro from $199 a year or LearnDash $350 a year for one site, plus hosting, domain, payment gateway and upkeep.
  • International SaaS (US dollars): Teachable, Thinkific and Kajabi from $29 to $399 a month billed annually, before Indian GST.
  • Indian LMS, monthly at 0% per sale: AllCoaching from ₹3,999 a month, Learnyst from ₹8,999 a month (₹8,099 billed annually), up to ₹49,999 a month.
  • Indian LMS, low fixed fee + fee per sale: Exly and TagMango from no fixed fee plus 10%, AllCoaching yearly from ₹6,999 plus 10%.
  • Custom-built app: agencies quote by scope; there is no standard published price.

The lowest headline price and the lowest total are often different plans. The rest of this guide shows why, and works out the total at your sales.

sections.h2: How we checked LMS platform pricing
sections.html:
We read every price in this guide from the company's own pricing page on 6 November 2026, wrote the fee per sale next to the price, and left a figure out wherever the page did not show it clearly. We did not convert dollar prices to rupees, because exchange rates move. For each option we looked at five things.

  1. Published price, monthly and billed annually where both are shown.
  2. Fee on your sales, because a percentage changes the total as you grow.
  3. What the price includes: your own domain, your own branded app, live classes.
  4. What costs extra: add-ons, setup fees, student caps, hosting and taxes.
  5. How you start: a free trial, a no-fixed-fee plan, or a call with sales.

Two changes since our last check: Learnyst no longer lists its Launcher plan on its pricing page[3], and TagMango now lists its Ultimate plan at ₹35,000 a month + GST[5]. Graphy's pricing page showed prices by country from our connection, so we do not quote a rupee price for Graphy.[7]

Disclosure: AllCoaching publishes this guide. Competitor figures link to their official pages and carry the date we checked them (6 Nov 2026). Prices change; check the source before you decide. If you spot an error, write to contact@allcoaching.in and we will correct it.

sections.h2: LMS price by type: what each kind of LMS costs in India
sections.html:
There are five ways to get an LMS in India, and each has its own cost shape: a one-off build, a yearly licence, a monthly subscription, or a percentage of your sales. Pick the type first; it decides most of the bill.

1. WordPress + an LMS plugin: from $199 a year, plus everything around it

Tutor LMS has a free core plugin; its Pro Individual licence is $199 a year for one site, excluding taxes.[12] LearnDash is sold in a bundle at $350 a year for one site.[11] The licence is the small part. Hosting, your domain, the payment gateway, plugin updates, security and any mobile app are yours to pay for and run. If a plugin update breaks checkout on launch night, you fix it.

2. International SaaS in US dollars: $29 to $399 a month, billed annually

Teachable Starter is $29 a month billed annually ($39 monthly) with a 7.5% transaction fee; Builder ($69) and Growth ($139) list 0% with Teachable Payments.[8] Thinkific Start is $82 a month billed annually ($109 monthly), and its branded mobile app is a $199-a-month add-on.[9] Kajabi Basic is $143 a month billed annually ($179 monthly) with no revenue share, up to Pro at $399, which includes the branded app.[10] Prices move with the exchange rate and exclude Indian GST, and you still need UPI checkout for students in India.

3. Indian LMS, monthly fee at 0% per sale: ₹3,999 to ₹49,999 a month

You pay a fixed monthly fee and keep every sale, before gateway charges. AllCoaching's monthly plans are ₹3,999, ₹5,999 and ₹7,999 a month at 0% commission.[1] Learnyst lists Professional at ₹8,999 a month (₹8,099 billed annually), Premium at ₹14,999 and Business at ₹49,999, all with 0% transaction fees, + taxes.[3] TagMango Ultimate is ₹35,000 a month + GST with zero commission, and its page lists a 1.9% Indian gateway charge on that plan.[5] Edmingle lists Core at ₹7,499 a month billed annually (₹8,999 monthly), + taxes, but does not state a fee on sales.[6]

4. Indian LMS, low fixed fee + a fee per sale: no fixed fee up to ₹15,000 a month, plus 3% to 10%

Here the platform earns mostly when you sell. Exly Starter has no annual upfront fee and a 10% commission; Pro is ₹30,000 a year + 6% and Premium ₹1,08,000 a year + 3%.[2] TagMango Basic has no fixed fee and 10% (including the Indian payment gateway) for up to 200 students; Pro is ₹5,000 a month + GST + 5.5% and Advanced ₹15,000 a month + GST + 3.5%.[5] AllCoaching's yearly plans sit here too: Starter ₹6,999 a year + 10%, Growth ₹12,999 + 7.5%, Pro ₹24,999 + 5%. Classplus is a flat yearly price instead: ₹29,999 for 1 year or ₹39,999 for 2 years, with no fee on sales stated either way.[4]

5. A custom-built app: quoted by scope

An agency designs an Android and iOS app, an admin panel and a backend for you. There is no standard published price; quotes depend on features, and upkeep, hosting and updates continue every year. You also pay the store fees: Google Play charges a US$25 one-time registration fee[14] and the Apple Developer Program is US$99 a year.[15] Our guide to white-label coaching app development cost in India breaks down the three routes to your own app.

sections.h2: Hidden LMS costs: what the headline price leaves out
sections.html:
The headline price is what you pay before anyone buys; the real LMS cost adds GST, the payment gateway, a fee on each sale, add-ons for your app and domain, setup fees and any cap on students. Most pricing pages show these in smaller print.

1. GST and taxes

AllCoaching prices exclude 18% GST. Learnyst and Edmingle list prices "+ taxes", and TagMango "+ GST". Exly and Classplus do not say either way on their pricing pages, so ask. Our guide to GST and income tax for online tutors explains what you charge students.

2. The payment gateway, on every payment

Every UPI or card payment passes through a gateway with its own fee. Razorpay's standard India pricing lists a 2% platform fee per successful domestic transaction, up to 3% on international cards, no setup fee and no annual maintenance charge, with 18% GST on Razorpay's fee.[13] At ₹2 lakh of sales that is ₹4,000 plus ₹720 GST on the fee (illustrative). Some platforms fold the gateway into their commission: TagMango says its Basic, Pro and Advanced commissions include the Indian gateway. See UPI payment options for online courses for the details.

3. A fee on every sale

Exly Starter and TagMango Basic take 10%, Teachable Starter 7.5%. AllCoaching takes 0% on every monthly plan and 10%, 7.5% or 5% on its yearly plans. A percentage costs little at small sales and grows with you: 10% of ₹10 lakh is ₹1 lakh a year.

4. Your own app

Exly lists a mobile app add-on at ₹60,000 a year; TagMango's Branded Apps Stack (Play Store and iOS apps) is ₹74,999 one-time + GST; Thinkific's branded app is $199 a month. Learnyst puts a branded Android app on Premium and Android plus iOS on Business; Edmingle puts branded Android on Prime and iOS on Power, both on annual commitment. Store fees come on top (US$25 once for Google Play, US$99 a year for Apple). Our guide to choosing an LMS with a mobile app lists what to check.

5. Your domain and custom-domain setup

The domain itself is bought from any registrar, typically about ₹600 to ₹1,200 a year for a .in or .com. Some platforms charge to connect it: TagMango's Freedom Setup for a custom domain is ₹24,999 + GST a year, and Exly lists a custom website add-on from ₹60,000 a year. Connecting your own domain is free on every AllCoaching plan. More in LMS with a custom domain.

6. Setup fees, student caps and storage

Read the limits as carefully as the price. TagMango Basic is capped at 200 students. AllCoaching has no setup fee and no sales limit, with unlimited students, and uploaded video counts against each plan's storage (YouTube video in your branded player is unlimited).

{{q:Is an LMS with no fixed fee really free?|No. A no-fixed-fee plan moves the cost to your sales: on Exly Starter or TagMango Basic, every ₹1,000 you sell costs ₹100 in commission. That can be the right choice at small sales; it is not free.}} {{fig:before-after|Hidden LMS costs: GST on the plan fee, a gateway fee on every payment, an app add-on, custom domain setup and a fee on every sale, compared with one AllCoaching plan with your own website, Android app, no setup fee, UPI checkout and 0% commission on monthly plans|Add the extras before you compare. A low plan price with three add-ons can cost more than one plan that includes them.}}

7 days, no card needed.
Check

Independent educators who want their own brand, website and app without paying for each piece separately.

Good at
Storefront, payments, CRM and WhatsApp and email automation for coaches selling courses, consultations and digital products.
Published price

Coaches who sell sessions or a few products from a checkout page and do not need their own app yet.

Good at
Courses, community and automation for coaches, with optional branded apps.

Basic: zero fixed fee, 10% commission including the Indian payment gateway, up to 200 students; Pro ₹5,000 a month + 5.5%; Advanced ₹15,000 a month + 3.5%; Ultimate ₹35,000 a month, zero commission (1.9% gateway charge listed); fixed fees + GST.[5]

Coaches running community-led programmes who are happy on TagMango's address at first.

Good at
Courses, mock tests and live classes with content protection, for exam educators.

Professional ₹8,999 a month (₹8,099 billed annually); Premium ₹14,999 (₹13,499); Business ₹49,999 (₹44,999); all with 0% transaction fees, + taxes; Enterprise on request.[3]

Exam educators whose main product is a test series and who can carry a higher monthly fee.

₹29,999 for 1 year or ₹39,999 for 2 years (the page also shows ₹34,999 and ₹44,999 next to them).[4]

Training businesses with several batches or branches.

7. Teachable, Thinkific and Kajabi (US dollar plans)

Teachable Starter $39 a month ($29 billed annually) + 7.5% transaction fee[8]; Thinkific Start $109 a month ($82 billed annually)[9]; Kajabi Basic $179 a month ($143 billed annually)[10]. Prices exclude Indian GST.
Free trial

Card processing fees, and the app: Thinkific lists a branded app at $199 a month; Kajabi includes it on Pro ($399 a month billed annually).

Educators selling mainly to students outside India who pay in dollars.

8. WordPress: LearnDash or Tutor LMS

Good at

Published price
LearnDash bundle $350 a year for 1 site[11]; Tutor LMS core is free, Pro Individual $199 a year for 1 site, excluding taxes.[12]

Hosting, the payment gateway, maintenance and any mobile app are separate and are yours to run.

Educators who are comfortable running WordPress, or have someone who is.

sections.h2: How much does an LMS cost in a year at your sales level?
sections.html:
At small sales, a plan with no fixed fee costs least; past a few lakh of sales a year, a fixed fee with 0% per sale usually leaves you more. The chart adds each published plan price to its published fee at five sales levels and picks the lowest-cost plan on each platform every time. It is illustrative and before GST and gateway charges.

{{fig:cost|Illustrative total yearly LMS cost in India at sales of up to ₹10 lakh, from published prices for AllCoaching, Exly, Classplus, Edmingle and Learnyst|Illustrative, before GST and gateway charges. Exly's line leaves out its app add-on; Classplus and Edmingle lines are their listed prices only, because their pages do not state a fee on sales.}} {{cost_table}}

The honest reading: at ₹1 lakh of sales, Exly Starter costs ₹10,000 against ₹16,999 on AllCoaching's yearly Starter. That gap is real, and if a checkout page is all you need, it is the lower-cost choice. TagMango Basic costs the same ₹10,000 and includes the gateway, as long as you stay within 200 students.

The picture changes once you add what you need. If you want your own Android and iOS app, Exly lists it at ₹60,000 a year, which takes Exly's total at ₹1 lakh of sales to ₹70,000. AllCoaching includes the app, your own domain and unlimited live classes in the ₹16,999. Classplus's listed ₹29,999 is lower than AllCoaching's lowest-cost plan above about ₹2.3 lakh a year, before any fee it may charge, and it does not list an iOS app. Learnyst and Edmingle cost more at every level shown, so compare them when you need a specific feature of theirs.

A worked example, all in

Say you sell a NEET biology course at ₹2,000 to 150 students: ₹3 lakh in a year (illustrative). On AllCoaching's yearly Growth plan, that is ₹12,999 + 7.5% (₹22,500) = ₹35,499; yearly Starter would be ₹36,999. Add the gateway at Razorpay's standard 2% (₹6,000, plus ₹1,080 GST on that fee) and a domain at about ₹600 to ₹1,200 a year. The plan price excludes 18% GST. Below about ₹4 lakh of yearly sales, a yearly AllCoaching plan usually costs least; above that, a monthly plan at 0% usually leaves more (illustrative, before GST). To set the course price itself, read how to price online courses in India, or run your own numbers in our plan finder.

sections.h2: Which LMS fits independent educators, by what you need
sections.html:
The right LMS for an independent educator is the one with the lowest total for the features you actually need, at the sales you will realistically make, not the one with the lowest headline price. Start from what you need.

{{fig:verdict|Which LMS to choose by need: checkout page and small sales, Exly Starter or TagMango Basic; own website and Android app, AllCoaching; flat yearly price above ₹2.3 lakh of sales, Classplus; mostly mock tests with a larger spend, Learnyst; students abroad, Teachable or Kajabi|Pick the row that sounds like you. The numbers behind each row are in the sections above.}}

Teaching on the side, testing demand (under ₹50,000 a year)

Keep fixed costs close to nothing until students pay. A no-fixed-fee plan or a free trial is the sensible start. Our guide to the lowest-risk LMS for early-stage educators compares free trials.

Private tutor or full-time independent educator (₹1 to 5 lakh a year)

This is where your own brand starts to pay back. A website on your own domain and your own app make students remember you, not the platform. Compare totals with the app and domain included; our guide to the best LMS for private tutors walks through three tutor profiles.

Exam educator selling test series (NEET, JEE, SSC, banking)

If most of your income is from mocks, compare the test engine as closely as the price. Learnyst is built around test series; AllCoaching includes test series with all-India rank and percentile on every plan. See the best platform for selling PDF notes and test series.

Skill educator selling abroad (yoga, music, coding)

If most students pay in dollars, a US platform's checkout may suit you better, even after card fees. If most pay by UPI in India, compare rupee plans first.

We built AllCoaching after watching educators spend more evenings stitching WordPress, WhatsApp, Drive and Zoom together than teaching, and we publish our plans on the pricing page so every educator can do these sums without a sales call.

sections.h2: How to choose an LMS by price in five steps
sections.html:
Estimate your sales, list your must-haves, add up the full yearly total for two or three options, ask about anything the page does not state, then test one real course on a free trial. You can do it in about 30 minutes, before you pay anything.

{{fig:switch|Four steps to choose an LMS by price: estimate your sales, list your must-haves, add up the total, test on a free trial|Do the sums with your own numbers, not the platform's example.}} {{steps}}

Step 5 is where most problems show up: buy your own course by UPI on a basic Android phone on mobile data. If you would not finish that journey, neither will your students.

faq: How much does LMS software cost in India?

On published plans checked on 6 November 2026, LMS software in India costs from no fixed fee plus 10% of each sale (Exly Starter, TagMango Basic) to ₹49,999 a month (Learnyst Business, plus taxes). Monthly plans at 0% per sale start at ₹3,999 a month on AllCoaching; yearly plans with a fee per sale start at ₹6,999 a year plus 10%. GST and payment-gateway charges are extra.
What is the monthly price of an LMS in India?

Monthly LMS prices on official pages checked on 6 November 2026 include AllCoaching at ₹3,999, ₹5,999 or ₹7,999 a month with 0% commission, Edmingle Core at ₹8,999 billed monthly (₹7,499 billed annually), Learnyst Professional at ₹8,999 (₹8,099 billed annually), and TagMango Pro at ₹5,000 a month plus 5.5% per sale. Taxes are extra.
Is a monthly LMS fee or a fee per sale better?

It depends on your sales. A fee per sale costs less while sales are small, and a fixed monthly fee at 0% usually leaves more once sales grow. On AllCoaching, below about ₹4 lakh of yearly sales a yearly plan with a fee per sale usually costs least, and above that a monthly plan at 0% usually leaves more (illustrative, before GST).
What are the hidden costs of an LMS?

The usual extras are GST, the payment gateway fee (Razorpay lists 2% per domestic transaction plus GST on that fee), a fee on every sale, add-ons for your own app or custom domain, setup fees, student caps, and on WordPress, hosting and maintenance. Add them to the plan price at your expected sales before comparing.
Is an LMS with no fixed fee really free?
No. It moves the cost to your sales. On a 10% commission plan, every ₹1,000 you sell costs ₹100, so it suits small sales but is not free.
How much does AllCoaching cost?

AllCoaching starts with a 7-day free trial with no card needed, then a monthly plan at 0% commission (Starter ₹3,999, Growth ₹5,999 or Pro ₹7,999 a month; you keep 100% of every sale), or a yearly plan: Starter ₹6,999 plus 10%, Growth ₹12,999 plus 7.5% or Pro ₹24,999 plus 5% per sale. Prices exclude 18% GST; there is no setup fee and no sales limit. Every plan includes your own domain and your own Android app; iOS is on Pro monthly and every yearly plan.
Are Thinkific, Teachable or Kajabi worth it for Indian educators?

They are priced in US dollars: Teachable from $29 a month billed annually plus 7.5% on Starter, Thinkific from $82 and Kajabi from $143 a month billed annually, before Indian GST, checked on 6 November 2026. They suit educators paid mainly in dollars; for students paying by UPI in India, compare rupee plans first.
Does a WordPress LMS cost less than a hosted LMS?

The licence can look lower: Tutor LMS Pro is $199 a year for one site and LearnDash is $350 a year for one site. Hosting, the domain, the payment gateway, maintenance and any app are separate, so add those before comparing.
How much does it cost to build a custom LMS app in India?

There is no standard published price; agencies quote a custom coaching app by scope, and upkeep continues every year. You also pay Google Play a US$25 one-time registration fee and Apple US$99 a year. An academy platform that includes your own app is the alternative to a custom build.
What is the right LMS for independent educators in India?

The one with the lowest total for what you need at your realistic sales. For a checkout page and small sales, a no-fixed-fee plan such as Exly Starter costs least on published prices. For your own website and Android app, AllCoaching includes both on every plan, at 0% commission on monthly plans from ₹3,999 a month or yearly from ₹6,999 plus 10%.
glossary: Everything an LMS costs you in a year: plan price, fee on sales, gateway fees, add-ons, setup fees, taxes and the time or money to run it.
A percentage a platform keeps from each sale. AllCoaching's is 0% on every monthly plan, and 10%, 7.5% or 5% on the yearly Starter, Growth or Pro plan, charged only when you sell.
The charge a payment gateway takes on each student payment, separate from the LMS fee. Razorpay lists 2% per domestic transaction on its standard plan, plus 18% GST on that fee.
A feature sold separately from the plan, such as a branded app, custom domain setup or extra branding.
Your total yearly platform cost divided by your yearly sales, shown as a percentage. It lets you compare a flat price with a commission.
An Android or iOS app that carries your name and logo, built on a platform's technology.
